newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea prices rise on overseas demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea prices rise on overseas demand.

text.p: Bangladeshi tea prices rose on demand from traditional overseas buyers at the weekly auction here on Tuesday, brokers said.
They said Pakistan and Afghanistan bought mostly good liquoring teas. Russia and Poland were also active but operated at lower level. The market had also support from local buyers.
Some 1.16 million kgs were sold. The average price was 45.65 taka per kg, marginally up from previous level.
The next auction will be held on November 26 with an expected offer of 951,000 kg.
